obligations.description: - **`Plans/FinalGUISpec.md`** — 22 addenda accumulated. Body defines Tiers tab, phase/task/subtask progress bars (3-bar layout), and `widget.tier_tree` as a primary Orchestrator surface. Later addenda introduce dashboard widget grid, rendering surface, scheduler/blocked GUI, but never reconcile the Tiers tab itself. The tab name, progress bar structure, and navigation model all assume linear phase progression.
